text:
Elaine S: FYI — HelioConnect POC is blocked by two gating items from their CISO: (1) BYO-KMS + attestation, (2) a firm private deployment timeline. Need quick exec alignment today. @Mike (AE) @Sana (Solutions) any blockers on our side? :slightly_frowning_face:
Mike (AE): Can we scope what 'timeline' means? Is 2-3 weeks acceptable? Also what's the delta if we offer Dedicated vs Private?
Sana (Solutions): Short: Dedicated is available in ~3 business days (reserved capacity) but BYO-KMS plumbing requires infra changes — estimate ~10 business days with KMS handoff and attestation. CISO also wants network egress peering + IP allowlist.
Eli (Eng-Platform): We can propose a hybrid: warm Dedicated pool + strict egress allowlist for initial POC. BYO-KMS needs infra review — I'll ping infra leads. If they accept temporary managed KMS + audit logs, we can unblock much faster.
Harper (SE): Filed a tight POC runbook: https://redwood.company/notes/helio-poc — includes a minimal validation step to prove egress + model selection. Example test snippet:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood-hosted/health --resolve helio-poc:52.23.12.9
```
Elaine S: Legal asked for a security questionnaire answer mapping for BYO-KMS. @legal-bot any ETA on contract language?
legal-bot: PR for BYO-KMS text in contract is open, reviewer assigned (Marta). ETA: EOD tomorrow.
deploy-bot: prod-deploy 2026-03-22 18:12 UTC — no impact to POC infra.
Sana (Solutions): Action items: 1) propose hybrid plan + cost delta (Mike) 2) schedule exec 30m sync (Elaine) 3) infra deep-dive for KMS (Eli) 4) SE to prep test runbook (Harper).
Mike (AE): I'll prep the exec brief and cost sensitivity. Targeting 4pm PT for sync — can everyone make it? :calendar:
Elaine S: 4pm PT works. If we can get a temporary managed-KMS concession, we can demo by EOW. :thumbsup:
Eli (Eng-Platform): Will scope infra impact this afternoon, update thread by 3pm PT. :eyes:
Harper (SE): I'll rehearse the runbook with a dummy environment before the call.
Elaine S: One more ask from the customer: they want a named latency SLA for the demo. We should outline fallback to a smaller quantized model and expected token cost delta. Mike — can you include that in the brief?
Mike (AE): On it. I'll include a short cost delta table and two fallback model options (int8 quantized + fp16 baseline).
Elaine S: Appreciate it team. Keeping this as single-thread status — pls post updates here and paste meeting notes after sync. :pray:
